item: A changed outlet_id trigger body now reaches an existing store
summary: ensure_source_outlet_id skipped any trigger it found by name, and CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS cannot replace one, so a store made by an older build kept the old body of the three trg_sources_outlet_id_* triggers. The boot step now compares the stored sqlite_master text with this build's (whitespace collapsed, IF NOT EXISTS taken out) and drops and re-makes a trigger whose body differs, in the transaction that heals the rows; a matching trigger issues no DROP on the steady boot. triggers in the return value counts triggers written. Planted-old-body test fails on the unfixed code; same shape as fts.py _heal_unscoped_update_trigger and _heal_raw_triggers. Lesson added.
